title: ANGRY FRUIT: THE GATHERING (Video Express cut)
style: Premium stylized 3D animated feature film still, original character design, anthropomorphic produce characters with photoreal macro food textures (real seed pits, pebbled skins, wax bloom, moisture), faces sculpted into the skin, slender plant-stem limbs, four-fingered hands, believable tailored cloth, cinematic lighting, anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, volumetric atmosphere, fine 35mm film grain. Serious, dramatic tone. No humans, no text, no logos, no watermark.
vertical_default: Vertical 9:16 composition of the same moment, recomposed tall rather than cropped. Keep the main subject in the middle third with clear headroom, and nothing important in the bottom fifth of the frame.
keep: Keep every character's face, proportions, colors, wardrobe and props exactly as they are in the start image. Do not redesign anyone. No on-screen text, captions or subtitles.

STRAWBERRY.short: man in his late thirties, low dry baritone, quiet and clipped, late-night-radio closeness, authority without volume
STRAWBERRY.full: Male, late thirties. Low baritone with a dry, slightly gravelled edge from too many nights awake. Speaks quietly and close to the mic, like a pirate-radio host at 3 a.m. Clipped consonants, short sentences, no wasted breath. Never shouts; when he is sure, he gets quieter. Pace: measured, speeding up only when he is proven right. Never warm, never jokey.

WATERMELON.short: man in his sixties, deep velvet bass, very slow, soft and patient, long pauses
WATERMELON.full: Male, sixties. The deepest voice in the cast: a soft, velvety bass. Funeral-director calm. Very slow, with long, comfortable pauses between phrases. Never raises his voice. Every word sounds measured for a suit.

AVOCADO.short: man in his forties, crisp precise tenor-baritone, expensive diction, mildly bored
AVOCADO.full: Male, forties. Crisp, bright tenor-baritone with immaculate diction and hard consonants. Expensive, courtroom-polished, mildly bored by everyone. Fast and efficient; every sentence sounds billable.

CORN.short: man in his fifties, sun-dried slow drawl, warm rasp, amused
CORN.full: Male, fifties. Weathered baritone with a warm rasp and a slow Southwestern drawl. Unhurried and amused, like he's seen every kind of trouble twice. Lets words land, then waits.

BROCCOLI.short: man in his thirties, very deep chest voice, flat, almost no words
BROCCOLI.full: Male, thirties. Very deep chest voice, flat affect, minimal words. Speaks rarely, and when he does it's short and final. Mostly communicates through breath and silence.

CHILI.short: man in his forties, bright fast tenor, salesman patter, you can hear the grin
CHILI.full: Male, forties. Bright, high-energy tenor with fast car-lot patter and a sing-song upsell rhythm. You can hear the grin in every line. Never pauses long enough to be interrupted. Optimistic past the point of honesty.

LEMON.short: woman in her forties, cool dry alto, measured, deadpan therapist
LEMON.full: Female, forties. Cool, dry alto. Measured, therapist-calm, perfectly deadpan. Speaks slightly slower than the room, with a small exhale before the sharpest lines. Never laughs at her own jokes.

POTATO.short: man in his thirties, warm earnest mid voice, a little too loud, seminar projection
POTATO.full: Male, thirties. Warm, earnest mid-range voice that projects like a motivational seminar, a little too loud for the room. Pitch rises with excitement. Completely sincere; there is no irony in him at all.

CARROT.short: man in his thirties, raspy nasal edge, street-tough, shouts well
CARROT.full: Male, thirties. Raspy voice with a nasal edge and a street-tough cadence. Talks out of the side of his mouth. When he shouts, it cracks and carries.

BANANA.short: man in his fifties, smoky tired noir baritone, slow
BANANA.full: Male, fifties. Smoky, tired baritone, like a noir narrator at the end of a long case. Slow, low and dry.

PUMPKIN.short: man in his sixties, wheezy grumbling bass, counts money in his head
PUMPKIN.full: Male, sixties. Wheezy, grumbling low voice. Short of breath and short of patience. Every sentence sounds like he's adding it to your rent.

GERALD.short: small high nasal male voice, earnest, pedantic, soft
GERALD.full: Male, small. High, soft, slightly nasal voice. Earnest and pedantic, the kid who corrects the teacher and is right. Quiet, careful, a little hurt.

GRAPES.short: six small high voices, fast, overlapping, mixed male and female, all talking at once
GRAPES.full: Six small, high, fast voices, mixed male and female, each with its own texture: one squeaky, one hoarse, one bossy, one whiny, one mumbling, one sing-song. They overlap constantly. Pitched up and fast; never in unison.

HERD.short: no words: breath, snorts, low grunts, pitched down
HERD.full: No dialogue ever. Heavy breath, steam, snorts and deep grunts, pitched very low. Never comic.

shots.name: Something Is Coming
shots.image: Complete darkness except for the faintest smoky reddish glow near the bottom of frame. Fine dust particles suspended in the dark. No characters visible. Deep blacks, volumetric haze, ominous.
shots.vertical: Vertical 9:16: a tall column of darkness, the faint red glow low in frame, dust hanging in the upper two-thirds.
shots.video: 0–3s: Total darkness, a faint red glow at the bottom edge, dust hanging still. 3–6s: Very slow push forward through drifting smoke. THUD... THUD... THUD: three enormous distant impacts; the dust jumps with each one, and the third is strongest. 6–10s: The glow pulses once and dims. Silence. Nothing is revealed.

shots.name: Strawberry Knows
shots.image: Extreme macro close-up of {STRAWBERRY} Only his left eye and the skin around it fill the frame, the small pale pit-scar of the missing seed just above the eye. Fine dirt and battlefield dust on the skin. Hard red-orange rim light, deep shadow.
shots.video: 0–3s: Extreme close-up, the eye closed, ash drifting through a thin blade of light. A distant rumble begins. 3–6s: The eye opens slowly, cold and alert, the pupil snapping to something off-camera. He whispers: "They're coming." 6–10s: Hold on the eye. Each distant thud makes the frame shiver; the eye does not blink. Very slow push-in throughout.

shots.name: Produce City
shots.image: Enormous establishing shot of a produce civilization at night: an old produce market grown into dense urban neighborhoods, giant greenhouse architecture, orchards woven through the streets, irrigation canals, lantern-lit stalls and towering organic structures. Tiny produce citizens move through the streets far below. Moon-blue light, warm amber windows, distant mountains and farmland. Huge scale, atmospheric haze.
shots.vertical: Vertical 9:16: a tall view down through layered rooftops, hanging lanterns and greenhouse spires to a canal street far below, the dark horizon in the top third.
shots.video: 0–3s: High above Produce City at night, gliding forward; lights and tiny citizens below, everything peaceful. 3–6s: Descend toward the rooftops. Birds burst out of the far fields and a tremor runs through the city: hanging signs sway, canal water ripples. 6–10s: Keep descending to a street corner where citizens stop and turn toward the dark horizon.

shots.name: The Herd
shots.image: Epic ultra-wide shot at night. Beyond dark farmland the Herd emerges through thick smoke against hard orange backlight: {PORK TRIBE} {BEEF TRIBE} Banners, crude iron war machines, hundreds of distant soldiers. Every figure is a backlit silhouette; no face, eye or mouth is readable. Dust rises behind thousands of marching feet. Imposing and organized.
shots.vertical: Vertical 9:16: low angle, one towering Beef silhouette fills the frame from the ground to the top edge, the marching army visible between its legs.
shots.video: 0–3s: Smoke and orange backlight over dark farmland; only shapes. 3–6s: The Herd emerges, silhouettes advancing in heavy synchronized steps that shake the ground; banners whip. 6–10s: One colossal Beef silhouette looms out of the smoke, horn edges catching ember light, then sinks back. The camera pulls back slowly the whole time. Faces stay black.

shots.name: Three Viewers
shots.image: {STRAWBERRY} He sits in his pirate-radio livestream studio inside a root cellar: earthen walls, a cluttered desk with a vintage microphone, three mismatched monitors, maps, photographs, a red-string evidence board and hand-drawn diagrams of troop movements beyond the pasture. Homemade but obsessive. A bare tungsten bulb and monitor glow, deep shadow.
shots.video: 0–3s: Strawberry jabs a finger at the map on his evidence board. 3–6s: He swings back to the livestream monitor, reads the viewer count and freezes. Flat, insulted disbelief: "Three viewers?" 6–10s: A distant THUD swings the bare bulb above him. The light rocks across his face. He slowly looks up at the ceiling. Camera nearly still.

shots.name: The Call
shots.image: {STRAWBERRY} He stands at the head of a battered table in the root cellar, now an emergency war room. A large hand-drawn map of Produce Territory covers the table. Empty chairs all around. He points hard at a circled location. Single overhead bulb, red warning glow, deep shadows.
shots.video: 0–3s: Strawberry rolls the map across the table with one hard push; the camera tracks the map. 3–6s: Tilt up to his face, both hands planted on the table: "Stop arguing. Start surviving." 6–10s: Hold on him. Dust sifts from the ceiling. He does not move.

shots.name: The Mortician
shots.image: {WATERMELON} He stands inside an elegant produce funeral home beside a closed casket sized for produce, back half-turned to the doorway. Strawberry waits small in the doorway behind him, out of focus. Moody warm lamplight. Dark comedy played completely straight.
shots.video: 0–3s: Watermelon stands beside the casket, back half-turned, and begins to pull off one long black glove. 3–6s: Finger by finger the glove comes off. Without turning around he says: "Everybody ends up here." 6–10s: Unhurried, he turns his head toward the doorway where Strawberry waits and gives one slow blink. Slow push-in throughout.

shots.name: The Lawyer
shots.image: {AVOCADO} He walks briskly down wide stone courthouse steps in Produce City, reading paperwork. Strawberry waits at the bottom of the steps. Late afternoon light, long shadows.
shots.video: 0–3s: Avocado comes down the courthouse steps reading paperwork, never slowing; the camera tracks backward with him. 3–6s: Strawberry steps into his path: "I need a war lawyer." 6–10s: Avocado stops dead, looks at Strawberry over his gold glasses, then slowly closes the folder.

shots.name: The Bondsman
shots.image: {CORN} He stands outside a gritty bail-bonds storefront in Produce City at sunset, hand still on the door he just locked. Strawberry approaches from frame left. Western framing, low warm sun, dust in the air.
shots.video: 0–3s: Corn locks the bail-bonds door and turns, sees Strawberry coming and lets out a long breath. 3–6s: Slowly he tips the flat brim of his hat down: "I know people." 6–10s: He walks past Strawberry toward the street, husk leaves swinging; the camera pushes in on the brass badge as he goes.

shots.name: The Bouncer
shots.image: {BROCCOLI} He stands at the velvet rope outside an upscale Produce City nightclub at night, neon light, produce patrons waiting in line. Strawberry stands beside him, tiny by comparison.
shots.video: 0–3s: Broccoli stands at the velvet rope, arms folded. An unruly patron shoves forward. 3–6s: Broccoli lifts the patron out of frame with one arm, no effort at all, then slowly turns his head to Strawberry and cracks his taped knuckles. 6–10s: He holds Strawberry's gaze while the neon buzzes. The line of patrons quietly steps back.

dialogue.line: How do you feel about Beef?

shots.name: The Dealer
shots.image: {CHILI} He stands proudly in a questionable used-vehicle lot full of strange produce-world automobiles, string pennants overhead, bright lot lights against a darkening sky. Strawberry inspects a battered armored vegetable truck beside him.
shots.video: 0–3s: Chili walks Strawberry past rows of strange vehicles, talking fast, arms wide. 3–6s: He slaps the hood of the battered armored truck. A panel falls off. Strawberry stares at him. Chili: "That ain't structural... mostly." 6–10s: The engine starts smoking. Chili keeps grinning and fans the smoke away with a sales brochure. Quick punch-in on Chili.

shots.name: I Brought Myself
shots.image: {POTATO} He stands heroically in the doorway of the root-cellar war room, backlit through smoke, plainly the least qualified warrior present. Inside, Strawberry, Lemon and Broccoli turn to look at him.
shots.video: 0–3s: The war room in near silence; Strawberry, Lemon and Broccoli bent over the map. 3–6s: The door bursts open through smoke. Potato steps in and announces: "I brought myself." 6–10s: Silence. Everyone stares. His enormous earnest grin does not move at all. Camera holds.

shots.name: Repossession
shots.image: {CARROT} He is behind the wheel of {CARROT'S TRUCK} The truck drifts sideways through a Produce City street mid-battle, sparks off the rear bumper, smoke and debris. Low camera at wheel height. No gore.
shots.video: 0–3s: Low at wheel height, the flatbed tears down a burning street toward camera. 3–6s: Carrot yanks the wheel and the truck drifts sideways around the corner, sparks spraying. He shouts: "REPOSSESSION!" 6–10s: An explosion goes up safely behind him as he accelerates away, tow chain whipping.

shots.name: Street Committee
shots.image: {GRAPES} All seven charge down a sloped street together in improvised battle gear, Gerald the green one a half step behind. The battlefield burns far behind them. Low-angle wide lens. They are arguing as they run.
shots.video: 0–3s: The seven Grapes crest the top of a sloped street, battle gear rattling. 3–6s: They charge downhill and instantly disagree, shouting over each other: "LEFT!" "RIGHT!" "SHUT UP, GERALD!" They collide and bounce. 6–10s: They recover and keep running, still arguing, Gerald a half step behind. Handheld chase camera.

shots.name: Fruit or Vegetable
shots.image: Massive heroic wide shot at dawn before the gates of Produce City. {STRAWBERRY} He stands elevated at the front, seen from behind and slightly to the side. Nearby: Watermelon, Avocado, Corn, Broccoli, Chili, Banana, Lemon, Potato, Pumpkin and the Grapes. Beyond them, hundreds of produce warriors fill the distance: {CELERY} {PINEAPPLES} {ONIONS} {BLUEBERRIES} Smoke, banners, sunrise.
shots.vertical: Vertical 9:16: Strawberry small at the bottom of frame on the rampart, the army rising up the frame in layers toward the sunrise.
shots.video: 0–3s: Behind Strawberry on the rampart, the camera begins to rise. 3–6s: The rising camera reveals hundreds upon hundreds of allies. Strawberry: "Tomorrow they won't ask whether you're fruit... or vegetable." 6–10s: The crowd goes silent. Wind catches the banners. Keep rising to the full army at dawn.

dialogue.line: Tomorrow they won't ask whether you're fruit... or vegetable.

shots.name: How You Want to Be Cooked
shots.image: Two Herd commanders standing side by side in smoke, framed from the chest up against hard orange battlefield backlight: {PORK TRIBE} {BEEF TRIBE} Both are pure silhouettes, faces lost in black, only tusk and horn edges catching ember light. Their armies fill the blurred background.
shots.vertical: Vertical 9:16: the Beef commander's horned silhouette fills the frame top to bottom, the Pork commander's tusked silhouette overlapping lower in front.
shots.video: 0–3s: Smoke thins enough to show two silhouettes side by side against orange light. 3–6s: Slow push toward them. The Beef commander lowers his enormous horns a fraction. Steam pours from their breath. 6–10s: Smoke rolls across their armor; only tusk and horn edges catch ember light. Their faces stay in black. Massive bass impact at the end.

dialogue.line: They'll just ask... how you want to be cooked.

shots.name: Stay Angry
shots.image: {STRAWBERRY} He stands at the front of the united produce army on devastated farmland, facing the distant Herd. Broccoli, Corn and Watermelon flank him. He looks small against the armies and completely determined. Sunrise behind the produce army.
shots.video: 0–3s: Close on Strawberry's face, the army breathing behind him. 3–6s: He whispers: "Stay angry." Then he charges, and Broccoli, Corn and Watermelon follow. 6–10s: The whole army erupts behind them. The camera races backward ahead of hundreds running at the lens.

shots.name: Collision
shots.image: Ultra-wide battlefield at sunrise: the produce alliance charges from the left, the Herd charges from the right as backlit silhouettes, moments before they meet. Dust and banners, gigantic scale. No impact yet, no gore.
shots.vertical: Vertical 9:16: the produce front line charging up from the bottom of frame, the Herd's silhouettes charging down from the top, the gap between them in the middle.
shots.video: 0–3s: Ultra-wide, both armies sprinting toward each other through dust and banners. 3–6s: The camera races sideways as the gap closes to a few strides. 6–10s: Keep racing alongside; the two front lines almost touch but never meet. Do not show any impact.

shots.name: Everybody Has Beef
shots.image: Close-up hero portrait of {STRAWBERRY} Battle-worn and dirty but unhurt, warm firelight behind him, embers in the air, shallow depth of field.
shots.video: 0–3s: Very slow push in on Strawberry, embers drifting behind him. 3–5s: He looks straight into the lens and says calmly: "Everybody has beef." 5–10s: He holds the look, completely still, while the embers keep drifting.

shots.name: Title
shots.image: Dark smoky background, red, orange, green and yellow light bleeding faintly through thick smoke, floating embers. The center is empty, kept clear for a title added later. Absolutely no generated text or letters.
shots.video: 0–3s: Drift through dark smoke as embers float toward the lens; a bass impact at the start. 3–7s: The smoke parts slightly in the center, leaving clean empty space. 7–10s: Hold on the empty center. No text.

shots.name: Shut Up, Gerald
shots.image: Three members of {GRAPES} Gerald the green grape in the middle, two purple grapes on either side, standing alone in smoky darkness under a soft spotlight. One purple grape looks irritated, the other exhausted. Gerald looks like he has a point.
shots.video: 0–3s: Three Grapes in a spotlight, an awkward silence. 3–6s: Gerald says quietly: "Technically... we don't." The irritated purple grape snaps his head toward him. 6–10s: The third grape shakes his head slowly. Gerald adjusts his spectacles.
